description.value: Anchors Inn is a small waterfront property in Ucluelet offering two cozy cabins and a one-bedroom suite, all pet-friendly and self-catering, operating since 2003. The suite features a full kitchen, propane fireplace, private deck with barbecue, and access to a hot tub. The property sits near the beach in a historically notable neighbourhood associated with pioneering botanist George Fraser.
